clauses.title: Period of insurance
clauses.text: Loss or damage occurring outside the period of insurance shown in the schedule is excluded.

clauses.title: Unlicensed driver
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising while the vehicle is driven by a person who does not hold a valid driving licence is excluded.

clauses.title: Unpermitted driver
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising while the vehicle is driven by a person not on the permitted-driver list, without the policyholder's consent, is excluded.

clauses.title: Unpermitted driver

clauses.title: Commercial use
clauses.text: Use of the vehicle for the commercial carriage of passengers for hire or reward, including ride-hailing, is excluded.

clauses.title: Commercial use
clauses.text: Use of the vehicle for the commercial carriage of passengers or parcels for hire or reward, including ride-hailing and app-based delivery, is excluded.

clauses.title: Goods for hire
clauses.text: Conveying goods for hire beyond the limits stated in the schedule is excluded.

clauses.title: Goods for hire
clauses.text: Conveying goods for hire beyond the limits stated in the schedule is excluded.

clauses.title: Intoxicated driver
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising while the driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs is excluded.

clauses.title: Intoxicated driver
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising while the driver is under the influence of alcohol or drugs is excluded.

clauses.title: Racing and speed trials
clauses.text: Loss or damage during racing, speed testing or reliability trials, including on a closed track, is excluded.

clauses.title: Racing and speed trials
clauses.text: Loss or damage during racing, speed testing or reliability trials, including on a closed track, is excluded.

clauses.title: Flood and water ingress
clauses.text: Engine damage caused by water ingress is excluded unless the Engine Protector add-on is shown in the schedule. Other flood damage to the vehicle is subject to the flood sub-limit in the schedule.

clauses.title: Flood and water ingress
clauses.text: Loss or damage arising from flood, inundation or water ingress, including consequential engine damage, is excluded where the vehicle was driven or started in standing water, whether or not the Engine Protector add-on is shown in the schedule. Other flood damage is subject to the flood sub-limit in the schedule.

clauses.title: Undeclared aftermarket accessories
clauses.text: Theft of non-OEM accessories not declared in advance is excluded; declared accessories are subject to the accessories sub-limit.

clauses.title: Undeclared aftermarket accessories
clauses.text: Theft of non-OEM accessories not declared in advance and listed in the schedule is excluded; declared accessories are subject to the accessories sub-limit.

clauses.title: Tyres and tubes
clauses.text: Damage to tyres and tubes is excluded unless the vehicle is damaged at the same time in an accident.

clauses.title: Tyres and tubes
clauses.text: Damage to tyres and tubes is excluded unless the vehicle is damaged at the same time in an accident.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: The compulsory deductible shown in the schedule is borne by the insured on each own-damage claim. It is separate from any sub-limit and from the policy limit.

clauses.title: Deductible

clauses.title: Sub-limits and policy limit
clauses.text: Sub-limits for named perils (flood, theft of accessories) are shown in the schedule and cap that peril only. The policy limit is the overall maximum for the period of insurance.

clauses.title: Flood
clauses.text: Loss or damage caused by flood is excluded unless the Flood Extension is shown in the schedule.

clauses.title: Flood
clauses.text: Loss or damage caused by flood to a property in a designated flood-risk postcode is excluded in full. For other properties flood damage is subject to the flood sub-limit in the schedule.

clauses.title: Gradual escape of water
clauses.text: Damage caused by gradual or repeated escape of water over time is excluded.

clauses.title: Gradual escape of water
clauses.text: Damage caused by gradual or repeated escape of water over time is excluded.

clauses.title: Unoccupied property
clauses.text: Loss or damage while the home has been unoccupied for more than 60 consecutive days is excluded.

clauses.title: Unoccupied property
clauses.text: Loss or damage while the home has been unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days is excluded.

clauses.title: Subsidence
clauses.text: Subsidence, heave or landslip is excluded unless caused by an insured peril.

clauses.text: The deductible shown in the schedule applies to each claim. It is separate from any sub-limit and from the policy limit.
